items.name: GenericAdapter
items.summary: Adapter for "simple" OpenDAL services whose operator is scoped at the bucket root: the URL host is the bucket and the URL path is the table prefix.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: A generic adapter for `service`, reading `opendal.<key>` storage options.

items.name: OperatorSpec
items.summary: Everything the generic factories need to build an OpenDAL-backed store for a delta table: which OpenDAL service to use, its config, and where the table lives within the resulting operator.

items.name: OpendalAdapter
items.summary: Per-service specialization for the generic OpenDAL factories.

methods.name: logstore_prefix
methods.summary: The prefix the log store's `PrefixStore` should apply on top of the root store. Defaults to [`OperatorSpec::table_prefix`].

methods.name: resolve
methods.summary: Map a delta table URL and storage options to an [`OperatorSpec`].

methods.name: wrap_store
methods.summary: Optionally wrap the raw `OpendalStore`. The default is the identity; an adapter may override this to rewrite paths or otherwise decorate the store.
